results.summary: This project implements a single-bit temporal coincidence detector that outputs pulses indicating whether only X1, only X2, or both inputs are high. It samples two single-bit inputs on each rising clock edge and classifies their relationship. The design is written in Verilog and requires no external hardware. The outputs are registered and update one clock cycle after the inputs are sampled.

results.summary: This project implements a basic SR flip-flop with reset and set inputs and Q and ~Q outputs. It is built using the Wokwi simulator. Pulling input 1 high sets the flip-flop, and pulling input 0 high resets it. No external hardware is required.
